2020_149_042120bdmtg.paragraph: The Troy School District Board of Education met in regular session at 7:00 p.m. on April 21, 2020 by Zoom video conference, and this packet carries the agenda, the Outstanding Teacher recognition, three sets of prior minutes, the February 2020 Treasurer's Report with a complete check register, unaudited financial statements through February 29, 2020, and four business items. February disbursements totaled $7,360,436.22 — $5,020,527.90 in checks, $2,076,973.08 in outgoing wire transfers, $234,379.70 in P-Card purchases and $28,555.54 in ACH debits. The most consequential action was authorization to accept Robertson Brothers Homes' offer of $1,425,000.00 for 6.12 +/- acres of the district's Section 1 property on Square Lake Road.

**Meeting**
Troy Board of Education regular meeting, 7:00 PM, Zoom Video Conference, April 21, 2020. District offices at 4400 Livernois, Troy, Michigan 48098 (248.823.4000); meetings cablecast on TS-TV Channel 19 (Comcast) and Channel 15 (WOW) Mondays and Wednesdays at 2:00 and 9:00 p.m. and streamed at http://vimeo.com/troyschools. Board: President Schmidt, Secretary Gary N. Hauff, Mrs. Anne, Mr. Gottlieb, Mrs. Hammond, Dr. Philippart, Dr. Wilson; Superintendent Dr. Rich Machesky.

**Recognition**
Forty-four individuals were nominated for the Troy School District Outstanding Teacher Award Program and 41 nominees were honored in a virtual celebration. Three winners were sent to Oakland Schools to represent Troy: Carolyn Maher, kindergarten teacher at Wass Elementary (Elementary Teacher of the Year); Amanda Fisher, ELA teacher and literacy coach at Larson Middle School (Middle School Teacher of the Year); and Jeff Rainwater, social studies and English teacher at Troy College and Career High School (High School and Overall Teacher of the Year).

**Consent agenda**
Minutes of the March 3, 2020 Workshop (Troy Center for Transition/IA-East, 1291 Torpey Drive; 6:17 p.m. to 9:50 p.m.), the March 17, 2020 meeting (7:01 p.m. to 7:24 p.m., with five members participating remotely under the Governor's Stay at Home Order), the March 23, 2020 Special Meeting and Closed Session (Resolution 20-038, closed session on negotiations under the Michigan Open Meetings Act, Public Act 267, Section 8(c)), and the February 2020 Treasurer's Report. Resolutions carried at the March 17 meeting: 20-034 consent agenda (Yes 7 / No 0); 20-035 Elementary Media Center furniture, $899,485.81; 20-036 audit services to Plante Moran, PLLC; 20-037 paging upgrades to The DataCom Group, $855,915.00.

**Business items**
Section 1 property sale — purchase agreement with Robertson Brothers Homes for 6.12 +/- acres on the north side of Square Lake Road east of John R Road at a minimum price of $1,425,000.00 with a $50,000.00 earnest money deposit. Niles demolition awarded to International Construction, Inc. at $356,385.00 from the 2019 Capital Projects Fund and/or Building Site and Sinking Projects Fund. **Business item A — Section 1 property sale.** Memo of April 7, 2020 from Rick West to Dr. Rich Machesky reported final and best offers: Robertson Brothers Homes, $1,150,000.00 original and $1,425,000.00 final for 31 lots; Three Oaks Land Acquisition, LLC, $1,300,000.00 to $1,350,000.00 for 28 lots; Clearview Homes, LLC, $1,250,000.00 to $1,230,000.00 for 23 lots, all with exceptions. Timelines ran 330 days, 375 days and 280-360 days depending on wetland approvals, each beginning once Executive Order 20-21 expires. The resolution accepts Robertson Brothers Homes' offer for 6.12 +/- acres of vacant land on the north side of Square Lake Road east of John R Road, part of a larger 70.647 +/- acre Parcel 2, together with an 11.281 +/- acre Parcel 1; the undeveloped portion of Parcel 2 and all of Parcel 1 are preserved in perpetuity through a conservation easement. Minimum purchase price $1,425,000.00 with a $50,000.00 earnest money deposit.

**Business item B — Niles demolition.** Bid 9906 for the Niles Center Building; documents issued by PEA and Associates, Inc. on February 13, 2020, pre-bid walk-through March 9, 2020, proposals received March 19, 2020. Tabulation dated 3/26/2020: SC Environmental Services LLC $197,711.00; Ahern Contracting, Inc. $232,000.00; International Construction, Inc. $309,900.00; S.A. Torello, Inc. $329,688.00; Blue Star, Inc. $355,600.00; Dore & Associates Contracting, Inc. $372,500.00; Adamo Demolition Co. $452,800.00; Homrich $529,000.00. The first and second low bidders omitted scope and withdrew. Michelle Kerns of Northville recommended International Construction at $309,900.00; Rob Carson, Director of Maintenance & Operations (1140 Rankin, Troy, MI 48083), added a 15% contingency of $46,485.00 for a total project request of $356,385.00 from the 2019 Capital Projects Fund and/or Building Site and Sinking Projects Fund.

**Business item C — Niles relocation millwork.** Barton Malow Company (26500 American Drive, Southfield, MI 48034), letter of March 17, 2020 from Project Manager Christa Amalio on Bid Package 29. Proposals received February 4, 2020 were originally awarded to FCI, which could not deliver prefabricated casework within its 10-12 week lead time to occupy the building by the first week of August. Advanced Building Group offered custom millwork with a four-week lead time at $161,300.00, a $1,300 delta from the FCI bid. Rob Carson's April 3, 2020 memo on RFP 9902 states an adjusted Niles Relocation Project cost of $1,353,003.00 with contingency unchanged at $120,300.00 for an adjusted total of $1,473,303.00, funded from the 2020 Capital Projects Fund.

**Business item D — Troy College & Career High School furniture.** Award totaling $96,390.54 from the 2019 Capital Projects Fund: Interior Office Source $68,764.98; Great Lakes Furniture Supply $7,843.00; Yeo & Yeo $3,438.00; Dew-El $16,344.56. (1191 West Square Lake Road, Bloomfield Hills, MI 48302-0374), letter of April 8, 2020 from Keri Seeney, NCIDQ to Christine DiPilato, Assistant Superintendent for Secondary Instruction, listed Category A Fleetwood, Interior Office Source, $31,487.00 on NCPA; Category B KI, Interior Office Source, $33,845.02 on Sourcewell; Category C Academia, Great Lakes Furniture Supply, $7,843.00 on KPN; Category D SitOnIt, Interior Office Source, $3,432.96 on Omnia Partners; Category E Ergotron, Yeo & Yeo, $3,438.00 on REMC; Category F Palmer Hamilton, Dew-El, $16,344.56 on Sourcewell. TMP Project No. 19128; project location 1522 E. Big Beaver Rd, Troy, Michigan 48083. General conditions set delivery July 20-24, 2020 with installation complete by July 24, 2020, liability insurance of $1,000,000 per person and per occurrence naming Troy School District as insured, payment of 80% of a bid category after the Architect's initial punch list, and no prevailing wage rate requirements for Oakland County; bidders file a familial relationship disclosure under Public Act 232 of 2004 and certification under the Iran Economic Sanctions Act, Michigan Public Act No. 517 of 2012.
